bear_case: The Korea circuit breaker session (KOSPI -4.45%, SK Hynix -10.96%) on July 2 reveals a structural fragility: the Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM narrative, however misattributed to HBM4, has successfully de-rated the entire Korean semiconductor complex by double digits in a single session. If this narrative persists through the 3-day holiday gap and spreads to US chip names on July 7 open, the NVDA full-size add fails to trigger for a second consecutive session, the GOOGL/META longs face tech-sector rotation headwinds, and the BUY regime upgrade becomes a HOLD recalibration within 48 hours of activation. Additionally: Warsh at ECB Sintra ('inflation too high') signals no FOMC pivot in 2026 — at Nasdaq P/E ~28x and 10Y at 4.49%, any further hawkish signal compresses the multiple math even in a Goldilocks NFP environment. SK Hynix Stop Day 1 is the most important near-term signal: if July 3 KST confirms Stop Day 2, mandatory exit adds institutional supply to an already-pressured Korean memory sector at the start of the holiday-gap period. Invalidation: July 7 open with NVDA >$200, SPX >7,460, VIX <17 simultaneously — that sequence locks in the full BUY activation with the half-size P&L recovered and the broader portfolio fully positioned for mid-July Q2 earnings season (GOOGL, META, MSFT, AMZN).
